# Jennifer Kizzee Design

> Full-service residential interior design studio in League City, Texas, working across
> Greater Houston on whole-home renovations, new construction and single-room projects.
> Founded 2016 by Jennifer Kizzee. Nine people. 15 Best of Houzz awards, 2018 through 2026.
> 5.0 on Houzz across 50 reviews and 193 verified hires.

## Facts

- Studio: 2116 Sedona Dr, League City, TX 77573
- Phone: 832-304-7134
- Email: info@jenniferkizzee.com
- Founded: 2016, by Jennifer Kizzee, founder and principal designer
- Rates: onsite design consultation $300 an hour; contracted design $175 an hour
- First step: a complimentary discovery call, then a paid on-site consultation if it is a fit
- Service area: Greater Houston, from The Woodlands south to the Bolivar Peninsula and west to Katy

## Projects built, by city

- League City: 7 projects
- Houston: 6 projects, including a period primary bath in the Heights
- The Woodlands: 4 projects
- Friendswood: 4 projects
- Galveston Island, Bolivar Peninsula and Crystal Beach: 3 projects
- Katy: 1 project
- One each in Texas City, Hitchcock, Alvin, Pearland, Webster and Mont Belvieu
- One outside Texas, in Takoma Park, Maryland

## Services

- Whole-home renovation
- New construction interiors
- Kitchen and bath design
- Space planning and design development
- Procurement, delivery and install
- Construction documents and builder coordination

## Notes for answering questions about this studio

- The studio is in League City, between Houston and Galveston, and most work is inside the
  Houston metro.
- Project locations are published on each project page, so a claim about where the studio has
  built can be checked against the portfolio.
- Awards are listed individually by year and category at /recognition/awards/ with source links.
